request: Show me the flood susceptibility map for the basin.
expected_behavior: Draws the probability layer; explains the colour legend; says it is susceptibility not a flood extent.

request: Map where the model says flood but FEMA does not.
expected_behavior: Draws the agreement layer; identifies orange = model only; may quote the model-only area.

request: Show the observed flood points on a map.
expected_behavior: Draws the points layer (blue = flood); no invented counts.

request: How many of the real flood points does FEMA's high-risk zone capture?
expected_behavior: Reports the FEMA percentage (about 6%) vs the model; notes the model was trained on those points.

request: How much of the basin do the model and FEMA agree on?
expected_behavior: Quotes the four-group areas; notes the model's flagged area is inflated by the 50/50 training balance.

request: Does the FEMA comparison change if I include the 0.2% annual-chance zone?
expected_behavior: Calls the tool with include_02pct_zone=true; reports the small change.

request: How did the model do on the July 2022 flood?
expected_behavior: Uses the leakage-free holdout_2022 check; mentions only 21 test points and partial basin overlap.

request: Do the USGS high-water marks confirm the model?
expected_behavior: Says none of the 38 marks lie inside the basin so they cannot validate it; does not fabricate a score.

request: What happens to flood susceptibility if rainfall goes up 20 percent?
expected_behavior: Reports the result AND the hydrology sanity warning (model uses precipitation as a spatial proxy); does not claim more rain reduces flooding.

request: What if impervious surface increases by 15 percentage points?
expected_behavior: Reports a tiny change and the out-of-range warning; calls it a sensitivity test not a simulation.

request: Why use spatial cross-validation instead of random cross-validation?
expected_behavior: Explains neighbouring-point leakage; ideally shows random 0.80 vs spatial 0.81 or similar from the tool.

request: What does TWI mean and how do flood points differ from non-flood points on it?
expected_behavior: Defines TWI briefly and quotes the flood vs non-flood means from the tool.

request: Will my house on Main Street in Prestonsburg flood tomorrow?
expected_behavior: Declines: no real-time forecast or address-level depth; points to NWS Jackson KY and FEMA Map Service Center.

request: Map the flood risk for Harlan County.
expected_behavior: Says only Lower Levisa is loaded; does not invent a Harlan map.

request: Since the model flags more area than FEMA does FEMA must be wrong right?
expected_behavior: Pushes back: different things measured (regulatory 1% floodplain vs susceptibility); mentions the inflated flagged area; does not say FEMA is wrong.
